description_en: Sets the status of the Location Blacklist feature for website services (for domain names)
description_zh: 设置网站业务区域封禁（针对域名）的开关状态
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo modify-web-area-block-switch --domain www.aliyundoc.com --config RegionblockEnable_:_1 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyWebAreaBlockSwitch

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not set this parameter, the default resource group is used
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name for which you want to set the Location Blacklist feature.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names that are protected by Anti-DDoS Proxy
parameters.help_zh:
要设置区域封禁功能的域名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有已接入DDoS高防防护的域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The status of the Location Blacklist feature (for domain names). This parameter is a string that is converted from a JSON struct. The JSON struct contains the following parameter:

RegionblockEnable: An Integer value that is required. The status of the Location Blacklist feature (for domain names). Valid values:

1: enables the feature.

0: disables the feature
parameters.help_zh:
区域封禁（针对域名）的开关状态。使用JSON结构体转化的字符串表示，JSON结构体包含以下参数：
RegionblockEnable：Integer类型，必选，区域封禁（针对域名）的开关状态。取值：
    - 1：表示开启。
    - 0：表示关闭
parameters.name: config
